description: Use this when the user asks which destinations OKstays covers, or before planning a trip through a country. Returns every destination with a ranking on okstays.com, with its country, slug and number of places on its lists (hotels, apartments, hostels and guest houses); pass country to list one country only. Read-only, no sign-in.

country.description: Country name to filter by, e.g. 'Spain'.
